rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something without difficulty or being readily affected.

example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 jung4 ji6 zau6 wan2 dou2 go3 wai2

rows.note: Use this for emphatic 'absolutely' or 'by far,' as in 'easily the best,' rather than for ease of action.

example.english: He is easily the best in the class.
example.traditional: 佢絕對係全班最叻嗰個。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zyut6 deoi3 hai6 cyun4 baan1 zeoi3 lek1 go2 go3

rows.note: Use this when 'easily' emphasizes being physically comfortable or relaxed, rather than merely having no difficulty.

example.english: After dinner, I can easily relax on the sofa and watch TV.
example.traditional: 我食完飯就可以舒舒服服咁喺梳化度睇電視。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 jyun4 faan6 zau6 ho2 ji5 syu1 syu1 fuk6 fuk6 gam2 hai2 so1 faa3 dou6 tai2 din6 si6
